messages:
kevin: heads-up — i'm taking a 15m break at 19:10 UTC, planning to hand primary to sasha at 19:05. quick preflight below, please ack and call out any gaps. :wave:

sasha: ack. i'll be primary after 19:05, secondary will be maria. where are the hot spots right now?

kevin: main points: p99 write latency on write-queue spiked twice in last hour (trace ID: abc123). no customer-facing errors yet but some increased tail latency for streaming responses. no active pagers.

ops-bot: incident-bot notice — no active pagers. historical p99 trend link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/p99?range=3h

maria: i'll shadow first 10m after the swap and take over secondary duties. any runbook pointers i should bookmark?

kevin: runbooks: KV cache warmup: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-warmup, Model-fallback & graceful degrade: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback, Streaming-throttle: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-throttle.

kevin: quick mitigations if p99 spikes pop: 1) enable short-term batching cap: toggle `batching.max_tokens=1024` in runtime flags. 2) reduce streaming shards: `curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/runtime/scale -d '{"shards":2}'` (ops role). 3) fall back to quantized model variant: use `model: gptx-q8-lite` in route bindings.

sasha: noted. do we need to pre-warm KV caches for the peak? i see a small cold-start at 18:22.

kevin: yes — pre-warm keys for recent prefixes. snippet to run locally (run from ops shell):

```
# warm up KV cache for last 3k prefixes
python tools/warm_kv.py --prefix-file /tmp/top-prefixes.txt --parallel 8
```

kevin: `top-prefixes.txt` can be pulled from S3: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/last-prefixes/top-prefixes.txt /tmp/`

incident-bot: pager policy check — current thresholds: p99_gen > 400ms for 10m -> page primary. alert channel: #oncall-pagers.

sasha: i'll keep the 10m window open and watch p99. if it crosses 350ms i'll push a throttled route to reduce concurrency. can someone remind me the toggle name?

maria: it's `routes.<route>.concurrency_limit`. reduce to 8 to limit in-flight tokens quickly.

kevin: also watch CPU on model-host-42 and model-host-46 (gpu-0). if those spike, use routing fallback to cheaper region `region: eu-west-1-fallback`. policy: `route_policy: latency_then_cost` will auto-shift.

sasha: oncall handover plan: at 19:05 i will post `primary: sasha, secondary: maria`, update bridge, and confirm runbook links. will keep 20m overlap.

kevin: perfect. one more thing — customer impact checklist: if errors >0.5% for 5m, file incident ticket with template: `INC-TEMPLATE-LATENCY` and tag accounts with high traffic.

maria: copy that. i'll be ready to take pager if needed.

sasha: posting handoff now: primary: sasha, secondary: maria, overlap: 20m, known issues: intermittent p99 tail, KV cold-starts. runbooks pinned above. bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/handovers/1999999999. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: handoff recorded — primary sasha, secondary maria, handover_ts 1999999999, overlap_until 2000000119. link to checklist: https://redwood.internal/checklists/handovers

kevin: leaving now. if anything flares, page me on #oncall-pagers and call mobile. back at 19:45 UTC.

sasha: thanks kevin — taking over. i'll monitor p99, model-host CPU, and streams. maria will monitor KV warmup. ping here if you need escalation. :raising_hand:

maria: watching metrics dashboard now. will post if i see >2 consecutive p99 spikes or any error rate rise.

sasha: quick reminder for mitigation commands (paste into ops shell):

```
# reduce concurrency on route 'stream-core'
curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/routes/stream-core/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN' -d '{"concurrency_limit":8}'

# switch fallback model on route
curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/routes/stream-core/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN' -d '{"model":"gptx-q8-lite"}'

# temporary disable streaming shards autoscale
curl -X POST https://internal-api/ops/runtime/autoscale -d '{"shards_autoscale":false}'
```

kevin: all good. leaving a sticky note in the runbook: "if fallback model materially reduces quality, revert with `model: gptx-1.2` and notify product evals"

sasha: noted. starting active watch. will escalate to on-call lead if pager triggers.

incident-bot: automated snapshot created for trace abc123 and metrics window 18:00-19:00. link: https://redwood.internal/traces/abc123/snapshot

sasha: thanks — will investigate if it repeats. everyone please react to confirm you've read handoff.
